high_level_description: The image depicts a formal interview or discussion setting. Two individuals are seated on white armchairs with gold legs, positioned across from each other. The person on the left is holding a microphone and appears to be speaking, while the person on the right is listening attentively. The background features a geometric patterned wall in shades of white and light gray, adding a modern and clean aesthetic to the scene. Between the two chairs, there is a small round wooden side table with a vase containing a bouquet of flowers, which adds a touch of elegance to the setting.
